Hi Evan —

Thanks for speaking with Tim. As discussed, attached is a short take-home focused on building a small service and reasoning about throughput/latency trade-offs. Key details below:

- Window: 72 hours from when you acknowledge receipt. If you need more time, tell us and we can grant one 48-hour extension.
- Deliverable: A short repo or a ZIP with implementation + a README describing architecture decisions and any benchmarking notes.
- Evaluation criteria: correctness, clarity of trade-offs, testability, and a short performance note (how you'd scale).

Please reply to confirm you received the materials and say whether the 72-hour window works. If you prefer a different format (Google Drive link or a private repo), we can accommodate.

Reviewers: Marissa Cole (SRE) and Jonas Weber (Backend eng) will each do a pass; we'll aim to consolidate feedback within 5 business days of submission.

Links/notes: Drive folder with template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xy_takehome-packages

Attachments: systems-takehome.pdf — includes spec + sample test cases
sample-workload-data.zip — small dataset for benchmarking locally

Best,
